# Dockio

Dockio is a founder-led AI systems integration practice connecting business priorities, enterprise implementation, everyday adoption and evidence of value.

## Services
AI business analysis, requirements and value prioritization; governed AI tasks, skills and tools; embedded BA/PM/PMO; delivery and integration coordination; selective development; adoption and outcome reviews.

## Working model
Agreed hours or days on time and materials. Scope, rate, review cadence, founder involvement and responsibilities are agreed before work starts. Finance is the preferred starting point; global and cross-industry enquiries are welcome.

## BudgetOps
BudgetOps is Dockio's vision for connecting business priorities, delivery, adoption and outcomes to better-informed funding decisions.

## Founder
Sankalp More. Background in statistics and artificial intelligence, with enterprise experience across AI platforms, governance, value prioritization and adoption.
